title: Staff hub Create and View use distinct URLs
summary: On APES CIC, Shelter, and Pet Care service hubs, Create and View now go to different places: Create opens the compose form, and View opens the list. Shelter Pet Profiles now opens the live pets list instead of a missing address.
changes: Give hub Create and View distinct destinations so staff can tell compose from browse.
Point the Shelter Pet Profiles hub label and View link at the live pets list.
Send the old Shelter and Pet Care pet-profiles addresses to the live pets list.
affected_areas: Shelter and Pet Care pet profile lists
version_rationale: Minor release: opens the Staff UX line and ships the first hub navigation fix without changing public own-record pages.
validation: PHPUnit ServiceHubQuickLinksTest covers distinct Create and View URLs on the three service hubs, the Shelter pets list path, and the pet-profiles redirects.
PHPUnit ModuleAdministrationAndNavigationTest and ModuleStateMiddlewareTest cover the Shelter hub pets route and alias middleware.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Create and list still share one page; putting the list above the form remains a separate change.
Public own-record hubs are unchanged until a later ticket.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore shared Create and View hub addresses and remove the pet-profiles redirects.
provenance: Staff hub Create and View URL fix for issue #136, pull request #209.
